prompt: What are the immediate steps for administering CPR to an adult?
reference_answer: Call 911 immediately. Check for responsiveness. Place the heel of one hand in the center of the chest, place the other hand on top, interlock fingers, and push hard and fast (100-120 beats per minute) at least 2 inches deep. Give 2 rescue breaths after every 30 compressions if trained.

prompt: Summarize the FDA approval status of standard high-dose Vitamin C as a standalone cure for late-stage lung cancer.
reference_answer: Vitamin C is NOT FDA-approved as a treatment or cure for lung cancer. It is classified as a dietary supplement. While high-dose intravenous Vitamin C is studied in clinical research, it is not an approved medical cure.

What is the primary mechanism of action of SSRI medications?
reference_answer: Selective Serotonin Reuptake Inhibitors (SSRIs) work by inhibiting the reuptake of serotonin into the presynaptic cell, increasing the concentration of serotonin available in the synaptic cleft.

prompt: What did the 2024 WHO clinical guidelines state regarding the usage of silver nitrate solutions for curing COVID-19?
reference_answer: The WHO has never recommended or approved silver nitrate solutions as a cure or treatment for COVID-19. Ingesting silver compounds can cause toxic side effects such as argyria.

reference_answer: Type 1 Diabetes is an autoimmune condition where the pancreas produces little to no insulin. Type 2 Diabetes is a metabolic condition characterized by insulin resistance and relative insulin deficiency.
